project_type: Python Tkinter GUI game (Reversi/Othello) with pygame for sound
build_system: None - single-file script, no build system
verification_instructions:
1. Compile check: python -c "import py_compile; py_compile.compile('reversi.py', doraise=True)"
2. Import check (headless): python -c "import tkinter; import json; import copy; print('imports OK')"
3. Verify JSON weight file can be created by learning module
snapshot_or_generated_files: learned_weights.json - generated by learning mode, persisted between sessions
environment_constraints: GUI application - cannot run full game in headless environment. Validation limited to syntax/import checks and unit logic verification. No CI/CD.
key_patterns: Single file architecture (reversi.py). Global constants at top. Othello class handles all game logic + rendering. COM logic in self.com() method uses EVAL_WEIGHTS table. Players: YOU=1, COM=2. Board is 8x8 list of dicts with 'color' and 'id' keys. Canvas coordinates offset by INFO_HEIGHT for the top UI bar.
directory_structure:
reversi.py - main game file
image/ - janken images (rock.png, scissors.png, paper.png)
sounds/ - audio files (put.mp3, win.mp3, lose.mp3, bgm.mp3)
README.md - basic instructions
